badge.reason: Internal tier: private, single-user app without public releases. An OpenSSF Best Practices badge applies to public Product repositories; reassess before the first public release.

fuzzing.reason: No complex parser of untrusted input is implemented in this repository: JSON is decoded by Foundation through generated Codable types, images are decoded by Apple ImageIO, and the only hand-written parsing (OAuth callback query, share-sheet items, URL routes) is small and covered by negative unit tests.
